qadirabad.teaches: The marker brightened in both channels while the optical new-water group contained darkening cells.
qadirabad.caveat: Mixed cover, roughness and moisture can change the sign. Compare dated optical snapshots and field observations.

chokwe.teaches: Dual darkening and departure from the observed baseline band use different rules and denominators.
chokwe.caveat: Cloud exclusions, a wet-season baseline, beta calibration and one assessment acquisition limit interpretation. Additional compatible radar and clear optical acquisitions would help.

richmond.teaches: A 10.24 km radar window returned no new open water on the usable optical comparison cells.
richmond.caveat: The optical snapshots cover part of the radar window and are offset from the radar dates. Clearer, closer optical observations would help.

san-marcos.teaches: The measured radar comparison and coarser optical groups answer different questions within one wetland window.
san-marcos.caveat: Crop cover, wind and mixed water or vegetation may influence return. Repeat clear optical passes and field records would help.

skollersta.title: Sköllersta rye trial, Sweden
skollersta.teaches: The documented trial date falls inside an observed focal-versus-annulus change bracket.
skollersta.caveat: The independent record dates the trial. The harvested footprint, moisture and management across the full window remain unresolved.

bug-fire.title: Bug Fire vicinity, Nevada, USA
bug-fire.teaches: Repeated cross-pol decline occurred inside and outside the mapped fire perimeter.
bug-fire.caveat: A perimeter can enclose unburned cells. Dated severity mapping and vegetation or field observations would help interpret the departures.

high-plains.title: High Plains off-event comparison, Kansas, USA
high-plains.teaches: The radar flagged repeated HV decline at an off-event site with zero confirmed vegetation loss in the supported optical snapshot.
high-plains.caveat: This is a comparison site for the sampled optical bracket. Soil moisture, tillage and changing vegetation can still produce radar departures.

kumamoto.teaches: A bracketing sequence of coherent pairs still has too few common correction-input cells for the readiness gate.
kumamoto.caveat: Ionosphere, atmosphere, unwrapping and the phase reference remain material. Verified correction conventions, redundant pairs and independent geodesy are needed.

choco.teaches: Two real GUNW intervals can provide coherence even when shared phase support is missing.
choco.caveat: Scattering changes and interval length affect coherence. Stable reference evidence and independently checked corrections would be needed for displacement.

palouse.title: Palouse upland comparison, Washington, USA
palouse.teaches: The focal patch and nearby annulus can change by different amounts on the same observed dates.
palouse.caveat: The mapped cropland at the point provides context. Tillage, moisture and phenology are unresolved without field histories.

matam.title: Senegal River / Matam, Senegal
matam.teaches: SAR departures are conditional on the chosen baseline and acquisition bracket.
matam.caveat: Surface roughness, vegetation and water can all affect the return. Compare separately dated OPERA snapshots before interpreting an event.

rowe-creek.title: Rowe Creek vicinity, Oregon, USA
rowe-creek.teaches: Radar departure can motivate a disturbance comparison under several plausible surface explanations.
rowe-creek.caveat: Moisture, roughness and vegetation structure all affect the channels. The native replay uses radar only. Independent dated event and vegetation evidence would help.
